title: Cardiff Castle
source: Retained exact-QID site outline, current PMTiles buildings/keep/courtyard hole and named north/west gates/bridges, keep stairs and two inspected pictures.
identityStatus: Reviewed approximate correspondence of the enclosed castle site, detached Norman keep, western palace, southwest clock tower, inner dividing wall, south entrance and northern/western approaches. Component roles, untagged architectural heights and profiles are picture-led estimates.
axis: Native +X northwest and +Z northeast. The source recipe preserves a cardinal authoring frame and rotates its output135degrees; the viewer inverse heading restores the mapped west palace, south clock/gate and northwestern keep. Both north/west bridge axes are within45degrees of nativeX.

nativeAxes.x: northwest along the mean of the two bridge approaches

orientationControl.basis: West palace, southwest clock tower, southern street/entrance and detached northwestern keep identified in the aerial and current PMTiles; native cardinal frame avoids ambiguous plan-axis facing. Output coordinate frame is rotated135degrees so both authored bridge axes satisfy the viewer longitudinal suppression rule; inverse placement rotation restores the same geographic footprint.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Standard DEM misses the small motte. Its approximate10.8m plateau, keep11.2m walls, palace/clock/tower/curtain levels and individual roof profiles are picture-led estimates at mapped plan scale. Palace floor2.8m clears the coarse western ground; perimeter walls follow retained DEM.
reconstruction.scope: Whole enclosed exterior: individual keep/motte/stairs, western palace/towers/roofs, clock tower, outer and inner curtains, south entrance, north/west gate bridges and simplified mapped visitor range. No full interiors, exact sculpture/clock-face lettering, gardens or city reconstruction.
reconstruction.coordinateSpace: cardinal-authoring-xz; X east, Z south; output points rotate by the frame heading into model-local-xz
reconstruction.componentControlMethod: Union of all current standard PMTiles tile fragments for each selected component ID, retaining mapped holes; cardinal authoring coordinates rotate by frame heading at export.
